mechanism_narrative: A low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) level compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, consistently producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% indicates recessionary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Weak GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is negative and INDPRO is declining.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), rising Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) triggers monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months, but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST) below 1600.0 indicates weak consumer demand, consistently producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is below 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales (RSAFS) combined with low housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS growth rate is negative and HOUST is below 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% in 3 months, but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.
